description: This file defines a PHP class 'ReviewEmployeeSupervisorSearchFilterParams' used as a data transfer object (DTO) for specifying filtering parameters when searching for employee supervisor reviews within the OrangeHRM Performance module. It extends a base FilterParams class and includes properties for employee number and name or ID, with associated getters and setters.

classes.name: ReviewEmployeeSupervisorSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for filtering employee supervisor review search results, allowing specification of employee number and name/ID, with a predefined allowed sort field.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters with a default sort field 'employee.empNumber'.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number filter criterion.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter criterion.

methods.name: getNameOrId
methods.description: Returns the name or ID filter criterion.

methods.name: setNameOrId
methods.description: Sets the name or ID filter criterion.
